verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a dedicated Vendors section in its data library, with documented Vendor Risk Assessment and security questionnaire workflows. Vendor data APIs and due-diligence workflows for reviewing vendor security posture are also documented. Together these show vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform rather than in a spreadsheet, but most of the evidence is page titles with little detail. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking vendor data access, configurable or recurring review cadence, detailed vendor-inventory documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
